cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A corrects a helper's seemingly sensible labeling and storage to protect an unexplained cupboard secret.
confusable: Practical delegation must acquire visible corrections; secrecy without those responses would be only the Drive.
comparison: Shared-flat belongings and access differ from a family-table departure.
seedUse: Keep the spare-key withholding seed but build corrections around labeling and a borrowed purse.
